features.name: Tenets of the Betrayer
features.description:
By their very nature, Oathless Betrayers do not share any common ideals, but may hold to one of the following tenets:

**Twisted Honor.** You still cling to your former oath, but distorted to serve your new purpose.

**Utter Depravity.** You follow some part of your former oath to the opposite extreme.

**Misguided Revenge.** You blame your fall on the actions of another and dedicate yourself to revenge at any cost.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description:
| Level | Paladin Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | hellish rebuke, inflict wounds |
| 5th | crown of madness, darkness |
| 9th | animate dead, bestow curse |
| 13th | blight, confusion |
| 17th | contagion, dominate person |

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain two Channel Divinity options:

**Command the Undead.** As an action, target one undead within 30 ft. WIS save or it obeys you for 24 hours. CR must be less than your paladin level.

**Frightful Bearing.** As an action, any number of creatures within 30 ft that can see you make a WIS save or are frightened for 1 minute (re-save at end of turn if >30 ft away).

features.name: Aura of Loathing
features.description: Starting at 7th level, you add your Charisma modifier to melee weapon damage rolls (minimum +1). Fiend and undead creatures within 10 ft also gain this bonus. At 18th level, the range increases to 30 ft.

features.name: Unearthly Barrier
features.description: Beginning at 15th level, you have resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

features.name: Master of Doom
features.description: At 20th level, as an action cloak yourself and chosen allies within 30 ft in darkness for 1 minute. Bright light becomes dim light. Primarily-sight creatures have disadvantage on attacks vs you and cloaked allies. Frightened enemies in the aura take 4d10 psychic at start of turn. Bonus action: melee spell attack for 3d10 + CHA necrotic. 1/long rest.

payload.name: Master of Doom
payload.description: Cloak allies in darkness for 1 min. Disadvantage on attacks vs you. Frightened enemies take 4d10 psychic. Bonus action: 3d10 + CHA necrotic melee spell attack.
